content.label: The app used to put exactly what I said now it just writes what it thinks I said. I hate that I cannot turn off Chinese and all the other languages I don’t speak. Choosing 2 max would be fine and leave the auto mode for who ever speaks 200 languages would be fine, but mostly everyone tops at 2 languages. It is ridiculous that I try saying something either in Spanish or English and it thinks I said something in Chinese and it writes in Chinese what it thinks what I said. Please change this approach transcription is not at all there yet.
